caption: The drawing depicts a single ankle-high boot positioned in profile, oriented with the toe facing to the left. The boot is colored in a light beige or cream tone, with shading that suggests three-dimensionality. The upper part of the boot features a lacing system on the side, consisting of metallic eyelets and a light-colored lace crisscrossing vertically upward. The toe of the boot is slightly pointed, and subtle contour lines indicate folds or structure in the material. Above and to the left of the main boot, there are two simple line sketches showing top views of the boot’s shape; one includes an outline of the lacing and the other depicts the general silhouette. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Shoe
